# Subway Seat for Raycast

Raycast themes are twelve colors: a walnut gradient, parchment text, a soft orange selection and the palette's accents for icons and tags. Custom themes need Raycast Pro.

[Raycast](https://www.raycast.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/raycast/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |

| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | `Raycast → Settings → Appearance → import, or ray.so/themes` |
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.link.txt`](subway-seat.link.txt) | `open in a browser or with `open`` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.json`](subway-seat-tunnel.json) | `Raycast → Settings → Appearance → import, or ray.so/themes` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Raycast → Settings → Appearance (custom themes need Raycast Pro):

```text
Open the raycast://theme link in subway-seat.link.txt — Raycast asks to add Subway Seat.
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Raycast → Settings → Appearance (custom themes need Raycast Pro):

```text
Open the raycast://theme link in subway-seat-tunnel.link.txt — Raycast asks to add Subway Seat Tunnel.
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Raycast → Settings → Appearance (custom themes need Raycast Pro):

```text
Open the raycast://theme link in subway-seat-enamel.link.txt — Raycast asks to add Subway Seat Enamel.
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `Raycast → Settings → Appearance → import, or ray.so/themes`.
- Delete `open in a browser or with `open``.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
